reserveReview.rationale: The October 1 rendered dashboard discloses USD amounts of $98,716,576 gold carry, $34,314,500 thBILL, $360,760 USDC and $20,000 USDT. Disclosed subtotals are $133,031,076 actively deployed and $380,760 liquidity reserves, totaling $133,411,836, consistent with the rounded displayed total of $133.41M. Independently recomputed total-reserve shares are 100 times each displayed USD amount divided by $133,411,836, rounded to seven decimal places: 73.9938666%, 25.7207314%, 0.2704108% and 0.0149912%, totaling 100% within floating-point tolerance. Source time is the dashboard's Last updated: Oct 01, 2026. The 74.21%/25.79% labels apply only to deployed positions. These are rounded issuer-reported amounts, not an independently attested aggregate balance sheet; internal gold-lease, futures-margin and Treasury-collateral allocations remain undisclosed.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: At Ethereum block 26088438, the disclosed Cash Wallet 0xec417ccb6dd26868cca993a92f37217b1d4b3c2f is a 4-of-5 Safe v1.4.1 with no modules and zero guard, receiving mint collateral. Theo's gold-carry explanation names Standard Chartered, Libeara, FundBridge and Wellington and claims CFTC-segregated futures margin at an unnamed US-regulated Fortune-500 FCM, but no account-level attestation, custody agreement or provider allocation is linked. These offchain provider roles and safeguards remain issuer claims; Libeara's tokenization role is not independent evidence of custody of every gold leg. MG999 bankruptcy remoteness and first-loss protection are issuer claims confined to that fund, not independently verified safeguards for the complete gold-carry slice or other reserve legs. The amount, availability and allocation of first-loss protection are not independently verified. Aggregate bankruptcy remoteness, segregation, rehypothecation terms and provider shares remain unknown.
